text:
maya: Anyone else seeing the hetero-gpu nightly red? Warmup failed on mixed-image nodes (H100 + L40). OOM during warmup only.
jiwoo: Saw it too. Log shows `invalid device function` followed by cudnn init and then OOM. Short stacktrace attached in CI.
rick: Ping eng-ml triage. Which images/drivers were used for that run?
ci-bot: [CI] hetero-node/warmup #482 failed on runner gpu-hetero-12. Link: https://ci.redwood.example/482. Exit: 137 OOM.
sre-bot: Alert: runner gpu-hetero-12 host driver = 535.86, container toolkit = 545.39 (driver skew).
maya: that's unexpected — our canary should have pinned host driver. Pasting relevant snippet:

```
E tensorflow: invalid device function
E CUDNN: cudnnCreate failed
E OOM: failed to allocate 2.3GB
```

jiwoo: can you try a quick local smoke with the same image mix? I can try repro on n1. If reproduces, we should bisect images.
anand: I can repro with mixed host/container on my dev node (host 535, container 545). Trying rerun with host driver 545 now.
rick: plan: if host=545 rerun fixes the invalid-devicefn, then we know skew is root cause for that path. If OOM persists, might be mem frag / concurrency.
maya: agreed. Also requesting a targeted rerun across hetero pool nodes pinned to host 545 before a full rollback.
ci-bot: Scheduled targeted rerun on nodes with host driver 545: job #483 queued.
jiwoo: Results from #483: warmup still fails but stack changed — NVML timeout then kernel fault (XID 31) in multi-threaded warmup.
maya: hmm, looks like two different failure modes: 1) driver skew -> invalid-devicefn, 2) frag/concurrency -> kernel faults/OOM. We should separate mitigations.
anand: Filing infra ticket to pin drivers and schedule rollout: INFRA-2145 created. Summary: pin hetero pool host drivers to 545 and coordinate canary.
rick: I'll open a PR to reduce warmup concurrency for hetero-job (lower threads from 8 -> 2) as a quick mitigation.
maya: sounds good. @rick please add a short changelog and mark me for review. If infra pins drivers we can re-run full nightly tomorrow.
jiwoo: If we need a deeper bisect, I'm available to run git-bisect across recent cuda-toolkit/image revisions on Monday; ping me with shard IDs.
maya: Cool. Tracking here. Thanks all for quick triage :thumbsup:
